plugin.typecho-plugin-scribe.name: Scribe
plugin.typecho-plugin-scribe.description: An OpenAI-compatible AI writing assistant for generating, polishing, and correcting posts and pages.
plugin.typecho-plugin-scribe.config.endp: OpenAI-compatible base URL. /chat/completions is appended during generation and /models is used for validation.
plugin.typecho-plugin-scribe.config.mode: The model ID provided by your LLM provider.
plugin.typecho-plugin-scribe.config.styl: Read the latest N published posts as style samples. Use 0 to disable.
plugin.typecho-plugin-scribe.config.outp: Auto mode follows the primary language of the title, body, and style samples.
plugin.typecho-plugin-scribe.config.targ: Optional, for example backend engineers or product managers. Leave blank to infer it from previous posts.
plugin.typecho-plugin-scribe.config.fact: Conservative; do not state uncertain facts
Conservative mode asks the model not to present specific facts absent from the context as certain.
plugin.typecho-plugin-scribe.config.user: Optional writing requirements sent with the title, body, and style samples.
plugin.typecho-plugin-scribe.config.incl: Extract images, links, and attachments from the current content. Images are sent as image_url where possible.
plugin.typecho-plugin-scribe.message.noR: No recent post samples are available.
plugin.typecho-plugin-scribe.message.noE: No additional writing requirements are configured.
plugin.typecho-plugin-scribe.message.lan: Auto detect: keep the primary language of the title, body, and samples.
plugin.typecho-plugin-scribe.message.aud: Not specified; infer the audience from existing posts.
plugin.typecho-plugin-scribe.message.fac: Allow low-risk common-sense inference, but do not invent concrete facts, data, links, or sources.
Conservative fact policy: do not turn uncertain or absent facts into definite conclusions.
plugin.typecho-plugin-scribe.message.ass: No body images or attachments were found.
plugin.typecho-plugin-scribe.message.api: The API key is invalid or not authorized{suffix}
plugin.typecho-plugin-scribe.message.mod: The model does not exist or the endpoint is incorrect{suffix}
plugin.typecho-plugin-scribe.message.con: Enter the endpoint, API key, and model name first.
plugin.typecho-plugin-scribe.message.end: The endpoint must use HTTP or HTTPS.
plugin.typecho-plugin-scribe.message.tem: Temperature must be a number from 0 to 2.
plugin.typecho-plugin-scribe.message.max: Maximum tokens must be an integer from 128 to 32000.
plugin.typecho-plugin-scribe.message.sty: Style reference posts must be an integer from 0 to 20.
plugin.typecho-plugin-scribe.message.ass: The body image and attachment setting is invalid.
plugin.typecho-plugin-scribe.message.req: The LLM request timed out. Try again later.
plugin.typecho-plugin-scribe.message.res: The LLM response format is invalid.
plugin.typecho-plugin-scribe.message.str: The LLM did not return a readable stream.
plugin.typecho-plugin-scribe.message.bod: Enter some body text before using AI {label}.
plugin.typecho-plugin-scribe.message.out: The output language setting is invalid.
plugin.typecho-plugin-scribe.message.len: The length strategy setting is invalid.
plugin.typecho-plugin-scribe.message.fac: The fact policy setting is invalid.
